body.prose:
Ownership in OpenLight was a stored placement, beside bodies: a single home, a name within it, and paths. On 2026-11-02 it was let go and the store made the namespace. On 2026-11-04 it came back in the body: holding is a reference that holds, a part may be held by many wholes, and names and routes are the holons' own. What was let go is ownership as a relation stored apart, and the single home.

*The author's, 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-04: we are back to one of the most prominent decisions around the primitives themselves, the one we leaned on simplicity for, dropping ownership and relates. Neither OpenLight's single owner nor the rule's several homes was taken for granted: we need to think for ourselves and be autonomous in our reasoning.*
body.title: Ownership as a relation apart
